fm_01.EN: Tushar Deshpande bowls a dot ball to Rohit Sharma. No score change.
fm_01.HI: Tushar Deshpande ne Rohit Sharma ko dot ball dali. Points me koi badlav nahi.

fm_02.EN: Rohit Sharma drives for FOUR (+4 runs, +1 boundary bonus = +5 pts for your team).
fm_02.HI: Rohit Sharma ne chauka mara (+4 runs, +1 boundary bonus = +5 pts aapki team ke liye).

fm_03.EN: Rohit Sharma is bowled by Tushar Deshpande (+25 wicket, +8 bowled = +33 pts for Tushar).
fm_03.HI: Tushar Deshpande ne Rohit Sharma ko bowled out kiya (+25 wicket, +8 bowled = +33 pts Tushar ko).

fm_04.EN: Suryakumar Yadav defends a dot ball. Score unchanged.
fm_04.HI: Suryakumar Yadav ne dot ball kheli. Points unchanged hain.

fm_05.EN: Suryakumar Yadav hit a SIX (+6 runs, +2 six bonus = 8 base). With 1.5x Vice-Captain multiplier, that is +12 pts!
fm_05.HI: Suryakumar Yadav ne chhakka mara (+6 runs, +2 six bonus = 8 base). 1.5x Vice-Captain multiplier ke sath mile +12 pts!

fm_06.EN: Shardul Thakur bowls a dot ball to Ishan Kishan. No points change for your team.
fm_06.HI: Shardul Thakur ne Ishan Kishan ko dot ball dali. Aapki team ke points me koi change nahi.

fm_07.EN: Ishan Kishan is out for 0 off 2 balls, triggering a -2 duck penalty. Ravindra Jadeja takes the catch (+8 pts).
fm_07.HI: Ishan Kishan 0 par out huye (-2 duck penalty). Ravindra Jadeja ne catch pakda (+8 pts).

fm_08.EN: Matheesha Pathirana takes a wicket (+25 pts) caught by Ravindra Jadeja (+8 pts). Both are in your team (+33 pts total)!
fm_08.HI: Matheesha Pathirana ne wicket liya (+25 pts) aur Ravindra Jadeja ne catch liya (+8 pts). Dono aapki team me hain (+33 pts)!

fm_09.EN: Ravindra Jadeja scores a direct hit run-out (+12 pts fielding bonus) against Hardik Pandya.
fm_09.HI: Ravindra Jadeja ne direct hit se Hardik Pandya ko run out kiya (+12 fielding points mile).

fm_10.EN: Suryakumar Yadav crosses 30 runs with a four (+4 milestone bonus). With 1.5x Vice-Captain multiplier, you get +6 pts!
fm_10.HI: Suryakumar Yadav ne 30 runs pure kiye (+4 milestone bonus). 1.5x Vice-Captain multiplier ke sath +6 pts mile!

fm_11.EN: Tushar Deshpande concedes 14 runs in the over. Economy rate crosses 11, giving a -2 pts provisional drag.
fm_11.HI: Tushar Deshpande ke over me 14 runs gaye. Economy rate 11 ke paar jaane se -2 pts provisional penalty lagi.

fm_12.EN: Suryakumar Yadav reaches 50! Milestone upgrades from 30 (+4) to 50 (+8), adding +4 base x 1.5 VC = +6 pts!
fm_12.HI: Suryakumar Yadav ne 50 pura kiya! Milestone upgrade ho kar +8 hua, net +4 base x 1.5 VC = +6 pts jude!

fm_13.EN: Nehal Wadhera comes on as Impact Sub for Mumbai Indians (+4 pts starting bonus).
fm_13.HI: Nehal Wadhera Mumbai Indians ke Impact Sub bane (+4 points starting bonus mila).

fm_14.EN: Rain stoppage! Match reduced to 16 overs. Overs remaining for bowlers are adjusted.
fm_14.HI: Baarish ki vajah se match 16 overs ka hua. Bowlers ke bache huye overs kam ho gaye hain.

fm_15.EN: Matheesha Pathirana bowls Nehal Wadhera (+25 wicket, +8 bowled bonus = +33 pts).
fm_15.HI: Matheesha Pathirana ne Nehal Wadhera ko bowled kiya (+25 wicket, +8 bowled = +33 pts).

fm_16.EN: Pathirana strikes again with LBW (+33 pts) and claims his 3-wicket haul bonus (+4 pts = +37 pts)!
fm_16.HI: Pathirana ne LBW wicket liya (+33 pts) aur 3-wicket haul bonus hasil kiya (+4 pts = +37 pts)!

fm_17.EN: Gerald Coetzee is caught by Ravindra Jadeja. That is Jadeja's 3rd catch, triggering the 3-Catch Bonus (+4 pts)!
fm_17.HI: Ravindra Jadeja ne match ka teesra catch pakda, jisse unhe 3-Catch Bonus (+4 pts) mila!

fm_18.EN: Innings break: Mumbai Indians finish on 148/7. Second innings starts shortly.
fm_18.HI: Innings break: Mumbai Indians ne 148/7 banaye. Ab CSK ki batting shuru hogi.

fm_19.EN: Jasprit Bumrah (Captain) starts the 2nd innings with a testing dot ball.
fm_19.HI: Jasprit Bumrah (Captain) ne second innings ki shuruat dot ball se ki.

fm_20.EN: Jasprit Bumrah BOWLS Ruturaj Gaikwad! (+25 wicket, +8 bowled = 33 base). With your 2x Captain multiplier, you get +66 pts!
fm_20.HI: Jasprit Bumrah ne Ruturaj Gaikwad ko bowled out kiya! (+25 wicket, +8 bowled = 33 base). 2x Captain multiplier ke sath mile +66 pts!

fm_21.EN: Jasprit Bumrah beats the bat outside off stump. Dot ball.
fm_21.HI: Jasprit Bumrah ki shandar ball, Ajinkya Rahane beat huye. Dot ball.

fm_22.HI: Bumrah ne ek aur dot ball dali.

fm_23.EN: Cracking yorker from Bumrah, safely defended. Dot ball.
fm_23.HI: Bumrah ka deadly yorker, dot ball.

fm_24.EN: Wicket-maiden over by Jasprit Bumrah! Maiden bonus (+12 base) x 2 Captain multiplier = +24 pts!
fm_24.HI: Jasprit Bumrah ka wicket-maiden over! Maiden bonus (+12 base) x 2 Captain multiplier = +24 pts!

fm_25.EN: Rachin Ravindra takes a single off Nuwan Thushara. Neither is in your team, so no score change.
fm_25.HI: Rachin Ravindra ne single liya. Dono me se koi aapki team me nahi hai, koi points change nahi.

fm_26.EN: Bumrah dismisses Dube (+25 x 2 = +50 pts), caught by your Vice-Captain Suryakumar Yadav (+8 x 1.5 = +12 pts)! Total +62 pts!
fm_26.HI: Bumrah ne Dube ka wicket liya (+50 pts), catch liya aapke VC Suryakumar Yadav ne (+12 pts)! Total +62 pts mile!

fm_27.EN: Bumrah finishes 2 overs with economy under 5 rpo, unlocking a +6 economy bonus x 2 Captain = +12 pts!
fm_27.HI: Bumrah ne 2 overs me 5 se kam economy rakhi: +6 economy bonus x 2 Captain = +12 pts mile!

fm_28.EN: Dewald Brevis was not selected in the match XI (NOT PLAYING) and earns 0 points.
fm_28.HI: Dewald Brevis playing XI me shamil nahi hain (NOT PLAYING) aur unhe 0 points mile hain.
